title: Language recognized by the adder family
statement: The language recognized by the adder family consists exactly of the Boolean strings that encode triples of bit strings $a,b,c$ with $a$ and $b$ having the same length as $c$, where the binary value of $c$ is the sum of the binary values of $a$ and $b$.
